pages.title: Compact Generation
pages.text: This is a $(l)single block$(), not a multiblock. Open it and place panels into its 36 internal slots. Their peak output and capacities are combined.

pages.title: Connections
pages.text: The bank needs open sky. Output varies smoothly over the day; rain gives 55% and thunder 25%.$(br2)FE is output $(l)downward$(). Six charging slots accept compatible items and charge each at up to 1000 FE/t.
